core.label: Ember Core
core.m1: The planet glows like a banked fire.
core.m2: A thread of light runs from the core toward a wreck.
core.clue: The Ember Core pulses and points at a wreck in the next sector.
core.ambush: Something rises out of the glow: an Ironclad.

site.label: Ember Site
site.m1: The site hums at the same note as the core.
site.done: The Ember Thread ends here. The hold is full of warm salvage.

quest.name: THE EMBER THREAD
quest.s1: Follow the thread to the Ember Site.
quest.j1: The Ember Core pointed at a wreck. Find the Ember Site in the next sector.
quest.j2: The Ember Thread ended at the wreck. It paid in salvage and probes.

skiff.label: SKIFF
skiff.blurb: A light, quick hull with the layout of a Cutter.
skiff.subtitle: FAST AND THIN
skiff.tagline: Hard to hit, easy to hurt.
